title: Paris, France
excerpt: The city of light never disappoints — croissants, cobblestones, and endless wandering.
content:
# Paris, France

There's something about Paris that makes you feel like you're living inside a painting.

## Highlights

- **Musée d'Orsay** — better than the Louvre, fight me
- **Le Marais** — the best neighbourhood for wandering with no plan
- **Café de Flore** — overpriced but worth it once
- **Seine at sunset** — absolutely free and absolutely magic

## Food

I ate a croissant every single morning. No regrets.

> *"Paris is always a good idea."* — Audrey Hepburn

## Tips

1. Get a Navigo pass for unlimited metro
2. Book popular museums in advance
3. Most parks are free and wonderful

title: Tokyo, Japan
excerpt: Neon lights, ramen at midnight, and the most efficient trains on earth.
content:
# Tokyo, Japan

Tokyo is organised chaos — every neighbourhood feels like a different city.

## Neighbourhoods

- **Shimokitazawa** — vintage shops and live music
- **Yanaka** — old Tokyo vibes, cats everywhere
- **Shinjuku at night** — overwhelming in the best way
- **Harajuku** — street fashion like nowhere else

## Food

I ate at a different ramen spot every day. The conveyor belt sushi was better than any sushi I'd had before.

## Getting Around

The train system is intimidating at first but once you get it, it's the best in the world. Get a Suica card on day one.

title: Amalfi Coast, Italy
excerpt: Cliffside villages, impossibly blue water, and limoncello at every turn.
content:
# Amalfi Coast, Italy

Probably the most beautiful coastline I've ever seen.

## The Drive

The road along the coast is terrifying and spectacular in equal measure. Hire a scooter if you dare.

## Positano

Everything is on a steep hill. Your legs will ache. It's worth it.

## Ravello

Quieter than Positano, with incredible views from the Villa Cimbrone gardens.

## What to Eat

- Fresh pasta with clams
- Sfogliatelle from any bakery
- Limoncello — the local lemons are something else
